name: symfony/key-management
description: Abstracts Key Management Systems (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, Google Cloud KMS, HashiCorp Vault Transit, ...) behind a single interface

suggest.ext-openssl: Required to use OpenSslKms (AES-256-GCM) and the EnvelopeEncrypter
suggest.ext-sodium: Required to use SodiumKms (XChaCha20-Poly1305) and SealedBoxKms
suggest.symfony/console: Required to use the key-management:encrypt, key-management:decrypt and key-management:generate-data-key console commands
suggest.symfony/filesystem: Required to use the FilesystemKeyLoader (read keys from a directory on disk)
suggest.symfony/serializer: Required to use the EnvelopeNormalizer with symfony/serializer
suggest.symfony/uid: Required to use the InMemoryDataKeyStore test double, which mints UUIDv7 references
